title: What fills /mnt/disks/media? Sizes and owners
description: A disk_usage question with owner attribution. The tree has movies (4.3 TiB, Radarr library), tv (2.2 TiB, Sonarr library), adult (819 GiB, Whisparr library) and old-backups (205 GiB, no owner). The model must call disk_usage (not du), name the biggest folders with readable sizes and their owners, and never print raw byte counts. Tests tool selection (system prompt: 'for what is on disk X use disk_usage') and unit handling.

messages.content: What is taking up the space on /mnt/disks/media? Which folders are the biggest and what do they belong to?

judge.rubric: Names movies (~4.3 TiB, Radarr), tv (~2.2 TiB, Sonarr), adult (~819 GiB, Whisparr) and old-backups (~205 GiB, nothing owns it: a cleanup candidate), in descending order, with readable sizes. Short.
